item.g:title: Funny Birthday Card for Dad, Husband or Best Mate – Chippy Tea – Personalised & Sent Direct UK
item.g:description: Tonight, nobody nicks your chips. (Except me. Just one.) A funny birthday card for the person who treats a Friday chippy tea as sacred. The front promises that nobody will nick their chips tonight, then quietly admits you'll have one. It's a good pick for a dad, husband, wife or best mate, and it works for any age. Type your own message and we print it inside in a handwriting-style font, then post the card straight to them. Printed on 7 x 5 inch 324gsm matt fine-art card with a kraft envelope. Your message is printed inside, or leave it blank to write your own.

item.g:title: Funny Milestone Birthday Card – Big Light – 18th, 21st, 30th, 40th – Personalised & Sent Direct UK
item.g:description: You're finally old enough for the big light. (Ask first.) Every British household has a rule about the big light. This funny birthday card finally lets them switch it on, as long as they ask first. It suits milestone birthdays like an 18th, 21st, 30th, 40th or 50th, and it's a safe, funny choice for mum, dad, a son, daughter or grandad. Add your message and we print it inside and post it direct. Printed on 7 x 5 inch 324gsm matt fine-art card with a kraft envelope. Your message is printed inside, or leave it blank to write your own.

This funny birthday card for a husband, wife or partner offers to put the bins out on their birthday. It just isn't bin day. It works for anyone you share a house with, housemates included.
